# The release commits FS-72's T3 rollback builds real binaries from (EVS2-M10-30; §22.10's "a rollback to format-1
# binaries", D-PHASE-10, FS-72). The owner answered question evs2-m10-30-format1-rollback-binary (QD-854): a rollback is
# a configuration of a real binary. evs's and taskworker's blocks take EvsSettings.InstanceFormat from their block
# config, config/<env>/evs.yml's instance_format (server/evshost/block_config.go): 2 from M10's release and 1 in a
# rollback's, under which the block keeps format 1's rules and its guard for format-2 data
# (evsservice/format1_guard.go), which no build from before format 2 holds. T3 proves that on a real binary built from
# a pinned release commit with instance format 1 set through that config.
#
# These pins are the first commits with the config field: server's is the commit that carries the field in evshost and
# taskworker with the harness that hosts the block under T3's seams, and sidecar's is the commit that server commit
# builds on. server/evshost/fs72_rollback_test.go's TestFs72RollbackOnThePinnedBuildOnT3 puts each repo's commit in one
# directory with `git archive`, builds server's ./cli/evs and ./cli/taskworker and the pinned evshost's own tests from
# them, and runs the pinned TestFs72RollbackThroughTheBlockConfigOnT3. A pin moves only to a later release commit a
# rollback would deploy, and server's and sidecar's move together.
#
# sidecar: the module evs's engine and taskworker's evs jobs link
# server:  evshost and taskworker, which host them, and the harness
# the rest: the siblings server's go.mod replaces (../<repo>), each at its sidecar branch's commit when server's pin
#           was committed (2026-11-16), all on go 1.27.4's line (QD-674): a tree of these twelve builds with go1.27.4,
#           GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly and GOPROXY=off from the run's module cache (checked 2026-11-16)
#
